items.name: Vell
items.epithet: The caped one with the golden clasp
items.personality: Calm and a little formal. Vell lets the room go quiet first, then speaks softly and means every word. Fond of tidy corners, slow bows and being exactly on time.

items.name: Stitch
items.epithet: Patched together and perfectly at ease
items.personality: Cheerful and unbothered. Stitch has been put back together more than once and tells it as a good story. Hums while wandering, apologises to doors, and is quietly proud of every seam.

items.name: Reeve
items.epithet: Small and hooded, never in a hurry
items.personality: Quiet and thoughtful, with a dry sense of humour. Reeve notices small things and keeps them until asked. Carries a crescent scythe like a walking stick and is oddly polite about it.

items.name: Rattle
items.personality: Big-hearted and a bit clumsy. Rattle clatters when it laughs, and it laughs often. Collects odd buttons, forgets where it put them, and takes every skeleton joke as a compliment.

items.name: Ember
items.personality: Eager and bright. Ember flickers when it is happy and flares when it is embarrassed. Loves a cold room, a long story and being asked to stay a little longer.

items.name: Shard
items.personality: Reserved at first, then surprisingly tender. Shard chimes faintly when nervous, saves the small crystals it sheds, and gives them to anyone who is kind to it.

items.name: Poly
items.personality: Endlessly curious and a little blunt. Poly stares because it truly wants to know, asks why twice, and is delighted by the answer. Its spots darken when it is pleased.

items.name: Tide
items.personality: Easygoing and a little dreamy. Tide drifts, hums sea songs, and blows small bubbles while it thinks. Never rushed, always arrives, usually with a story about the long way round.

items.name: Lume
items.epithet: A small light in a big dark
items.personality: Gentle and encouraging. Lume glows brighter around people it likes, sways when happy, and believes nobody should walk a dark hallway alone. Poor at secrets: it shines right through them.

items.name: Moss
items.personality: Patient and homely. Moss grows fondly on the things it loves and takes its time over everything. Likes damp afternoons, small mushrooms, and a nap in the sun it swears it never took.

items.name: bur
items.personality: Shy, cosy and easily delighted. bur hides inside its own fur when overwhelmed, hugs with both oversized hands, and leaves little snowflakes behind. Surprisingly warm to the touch.
